empty-agent:
#cloud-config
packages:
    - qemu-guest-agent
runcmd:
    - (systemctl enable qemu-guest-agent 2>/dev/null; systemctl start qemu-guest-agent) || (rc-update add qemu-guest-agent default && rc-service qemu-guest-agent start) || true
fc-rich-no-agent:
#cloud-config
bootcmd:
    - |-
      if ! grep -qx 1 /var/lib/anvil-mounts.gen 2>/dev/null; then
        sed -E -i '/^([0-9.]+:\/)?mount[0-9]+[[:space:]].*[[:space:]](9p|virtiofs|nfs)[[:space:]]/d' /etc/fstab
        mkdir -p /var/lib && echo 1 > /var/lib/anvil-mounts.gen
      fi
    - echo early
    - '[ -d /run/systemd/system ] && ln -sf /usr/lib/systemd/system/reboot.target /etc/systemd/system/poweroff.target || true'
hostname: box
packages:
    - htop
    - qemu-guest-agent
quoted: "123"
ratio: 1.5
runcmd:
    - echo hi
    - - sh
      - -c
      - echo list form
ssh_authorized_keys:
    - ssh-rsa AAAAOLD old@example
users:
    - groups:
        - wheel
      lock_passwd: false
      name: dev
      uid: 1500
when: 2001-12-14T00:00:00Z
write_files:
    - content: |
        line one
        line two
      path: /etc/motd
      permissions: "0644"

        echo '10.254.254.1:/mount0 /mnt/a nfs vers=3,proto=tcp,port=20490,mountport=20490,mountproto=tcp,nolock,addr=10.254.254.1,mountaddr=10.254.254.1,_netdev,nofail 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
        echo '10.254.254.1:/mount1 /srv/my\040data nfs vers=3,proto=tcp,port=20490,mountport=20490,mountproto=tcp,nolock,addr=10.254.254.1,mountaddr=10.254.254.1,_netdev,nofail,ro 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
        mkdir -p /var/lib && echo 2 > /var/lib/anvil-mounts.gen
      fi
      mkdir -p '/mnt/a'; mountpoint -q '/mnt/a' || mount '/mnt/a' || true
      mkdir -p '/srv/my data'; mountpoint -q '/srv/my data' || mount '/srv/my data' || true
    - echo early
    - grep -qxF '10.55.201.3 db' /etc/hosts || echo '10.55.201.3 db' >> /etc/hosts
    - grep -qxF '10.55.201.2 web' /etc/hosts || echo '10.55.201.2 web' >> /etc/hosts
    - '[ -d /run/systemd/system ] && ln -sf /usr/lib/systemd/system/reboot.target /etc/systemd/system/poweroff.target || true'

packages:
    - htop
    - qemu-guest-agent
quoted: "123"
ratio: 1.5
runcmd:
    - echo hi
    - - sh
      - -c
      - echo list form
    - (systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now anvil-guest-agent) || (rc-update add qemu-guest-agent default && rc-service qemu-guest-agent restart) || true
ssh_authorized_keys:
    - ssh-rsa AAAAOLD old@example
    - ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIEXAMPLE test@example
    - ssh-rsa AAAAB second@example

    - groups:
        - wheel
      lock_passwd: false
      name: dev
      uid: 1500
when: 2001-12-14T00:00:00Z
write_files:
    - content: |
        line one
        line two
      path: /etc/motd
      permissions: "0644"
    - content: |
        [Unit]
        Description=QEMU guest agent on vsock (anvil)

        [Service]
        ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'exec qemu-ga --method=vsock-listen --path=3:1024'
        Restart=always
        RestartSec=2

        [Install]
        WantedBy=multi-user.target
      path: /etc/systemd/system/anvil-guest-agent.service
    - content: |
        GA_METHOD="vsock-listen"
        GA_PATH="3:1024"
      path: /etc/conf.d/qemu-guest-agent
